cases.translation: Your silver and gold are mine.
cases.explain: The predicate nominative requires the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я посылал требовать твоего ___ и золота.
cases.translation: I sent to demand your silver and gold.
cases.explain: The verb "требовать" (to demand) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Пошлю слуг обыскать твой ___ и дома твоих приближенных.
cases.translation: I will send servants to search your palace and houses.
cases.explain: The verb "обыскать" (to search) governs the accusative case.

cases.translation: Summoned all the elders of the land.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession or relationship with "страны" (of the land).

cases.sentence: Винодат пил в своих ___ со своими союзниками.
cases.translation: Ben Hadad was drinking in his tents with his allies.
cases.explain: The preposition "в" with location uses the prepositional case.

cases.translation: The young servants of the district governors went out first.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession with "слуги" (servants of).

cases.sentence: Израилетяне нанесли потери в сто тысяч воинов за один ___.
cases.translation: The Israelites killed one hundred thousand soldiers in one day.
cases.explain: The temporal accusative indicates duration or a point in time.

cases.translation: The rest fled into the city of Aphek.
cases.explain: The preposition "в" with motion (where one is going) uses the accusative case.

reading.ru: Винодат, царь Арама, собрал войско, и с ним было 32 царя с конями и колесницами.
reading.question: How many kings were with Ben Hadad?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states there were 32 kings with horses and chariots with Ben Hadad.

reading.ru: Они вышли в полдень, когда Винодат и его союзники напились в своих шатрах.
reading.question: What were Ben Hadad and his allies doing?
reading.explain: The text clearly states that Ben Hadad and the allied kings were drinking in their pavilions.

reading.ru: Каждый сразил своего противника, арамеи бежали, и Израиль преследовал их.
reading.question: What happened after the attack?
options: Each Israeli killed his opponent and the Arameans fled
reading.correct: Each Israeli killed his opponent and the Arameans fled
reading.explain: The text says each man struck down his opponent and the Syrians fled.

reading.ru: Послушай, мы слышали, что цари из дома Израиля милостивы.
reading.question: What reputation did Israel's kings have?
reading.explain: Ben Hadad's servants said the kings of Israel were known to be merciful.

reading.ru: Твой слуга Винодат говорит, прошу тебя, оставь мне жизнь.
reading.question: What did Ben Hadad request?
reading.explain: Ben Hadad's servants pleaded for his life to be spared.

reading.ru: По слову Господа один из пророков сказал другому, «Прошу, побей меня».
reading.question: What did one prophet ask another?
reading.explain: A prophet requested that another strike him according to God's word.
